{{Quote|Attention, all officers and crews of the Coruscant Imperial Third Fleet. This is Admiral Kelsan.|Admiral Peto Kelsan|<ref name="Legacy (2006) 36">[[Legacy (2006) 36|''Legacy'' (2006) 36]]</ref>}}
The '''Coruscant Third Fleet''' was one of the [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] of [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Empire]] in [[137 ABY]].

==History==
Commanded by Admiral [[Peto Kelsan]], this fleet participated in the [[Battle of Ralltiir (Second Imperial Civil War)|Battle of Ralltiir]], where it stood against both [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]] and the [[Empire-in-exile]], who wanted to capture as many of its ships as possible. Realizing that his forces were badly outnumbered, Kelsan ordered the crews of all his ships to set the ships for self-destruct and then leave them in the [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]]. Peto Kelsan himself choose to stay on his ship, [[Avenger (Pellaeon-class)|''Avenger'']] and perished along with the fleet. The only remaining ship of the fleet was [[Ardent-class fast frigate|''Ardent''-class fast frigate]] [[Steadfast (Ardent-class)|''Steadfast'']], which took some damage that disabled its self-destruct mechanism. Admiral [[Gar Stazi]] of the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]] decided to deposit both its [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Vaclen Tor]] and his crew to the surface of [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]] and then send the ship to [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]] as a gift.
